subject: Novacorp exec intro and demo — VP/CIO attendance coordination
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Elena Park <elena.park@novacorp.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Novacorp IT Sec <security@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec intro & demo next week

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the intro call yesterday. We had a quick sync internally and Novacorp would like a short, exec-focused demo next week to evaluate Redwood for a pilot. The ask from leadership is simple: a 30-45 minute session that covers high-level architecture, data controls, and a short walkthrough of an inference scenario similar to our production workload.

Attendees we are trying to confirm:
- Priya Desai, VP Engineering (decision-maker)
- Marcus Liu, CIO (technical sponsor)
- Myself (program lead)

Can you propose 2 options next week (PST) that would work for a VP + CIO? We prefer morning windows (9-11am PT) if possible. Also our security team (cc'd) will want a separate follow-up to go through the questionnaire and, if needed, evidence.

Objectives:
- Confirm fit for a small pilot (throughput + latency constraints)
- High-level security/data controls overview
- Next steps: mutual action plan and timelines

Attachments: Novacorp_exec_priorities.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Elena Park
Director, Strategic Programs
Novacorp

-----Reply-----
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Novacorp IT Sec <security@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:23:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec intro & demo next week

Thanks Elena — great to meet you.

Quick response with availability and a proposed run-of-show. Karthik (cc) will lead the demo; I’ll join for the security/control brief and Grace will act as executive liaison and follow-up owner.

Proposed slots (all PT):
1) Wed 9 Jun — 09:30–10:15 (30–45m)
2) Thu 10 Jun — 10:00–10:45 (30–45m)

Run-of-show (30–45m):
- 5m: quick intros + objectives
- 15m: product walkthrough (Karthik) — real workload walk-through, perf expectations
- 10m: security & data controls (Maya) — isolation, KMS, logging/audit
- 10m: Q&A and next steps (action plan + timelines)

Attachments: Maya_May_Demo_Agenda.pdf (PDF) — agenda + suggested demo script

If both look tight for Priya & Marcus, we can also do a 20-minute exec intro + separate technical deep-dive with your security team later that week. Let me know which slot you prefer and who will join from Novacorp by name and title so we can tailor the walkthrough.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
maya.srinivasan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Novacorp IT Sec <security@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec intro & demo next week

Hi Maya — thanks for the quick turnaround.

Marcus (CIO) confirmed he can make the Wed 9 Jun 09:30 PT slot. Priya will be out of office that day but can join the Thu 10 Jun slot if you prefer a two-date approach. For decision-making momentum we'd prefer to run a single consolidated session with Marcus + Priya if possible — she can carve 20-25 minutes on Thu but Wed works for Marcus and is earlier. Could we do Wed 09:30 and keep Thu 10:00 as a backup?

Security requests:
- I attached the security questionnaire; can Karthik + Maya review and reply with any clarifying notes before Wed? (attached: Novacorp_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx)
- Marcus asked for SOC2-related artifacts (summary and if available a latest report or contact to request it).

We will plan attendees: Marcus Liu (CIO), Elena Park (Director), plus Novacorp Sec (TBD). Please send a calendar invite with Zoom link and the agenda you attached.

Elena

Elena Park
Director, Strategic Programs | Novacorp
elena.park@novacorp.com | +1 (206) 555-0123
